description: Cancel a CLOB order. Pass orderHash to cancel a specific order, or set cancelAll: true to cancel ALL open orders at once via on-chain nonce bump (affects all markets, irreversible). Mass cancel is a single transaction — efficient but cancels everything. Returns transaction hash for confirmation.

cancelAll.description: Set to true to cancel ALL open orders at once via nonce bump. Affects all markets, irreversible. When true, orderHash is ignored.

orderHash.description: Hash of the specific order to cancel (0x + 64 hex chars). Get this from get_orders response. Required unless cancelAll is true.

name: cancel_order
